description_expanded: OverviewBlue Mountain Beach Townhome with Private beach access, Gulf Views, on-site golf cart - Seacliffs 13The Space Sea Cliffs #13 - Gulf Views and Golf Cart! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Spacious Townhome – Beautifully designed for a relaxing coastal getaway Steps to the Beach – Just a short stroll to Blue Mountain Beach’s white sands Open-Concept Living Area – Light-filled, modern space with coastal-chic décor Fully Equipped Kitchen – High-end appliances & plenty of space for cooking Outdoor Patio – Unwind with fresh sea breezes & gorgeous sunsets Prime Location – Near Seaside, Grayton Beach, and 30A’s best restaurants & shops 3 Adult Bikes - 3 beach cruiser bikes provided with each stay GOLF CART - 6 seater golf cart available for rent with Emerald Coast Beach ServicePRIVATE Deeded Beach Access - Plenty of space on the beach to enjoy! Gulf Views!– Views from both balconies! Welcome to Sea Cliffs #13Your next unforgettable beach escape begins at Sea Cliffs #13, nestled in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach along scenic 30A. This laid-back retreat places you just steps from the pristine Gulf shores, while also keeping you close to beloved local dining spots and charming boutiques.This delightful three-story town home boasts stunning Gulf views from the second and third floors, creating the perfect setting for your beachside escape. The lower level includes a bunk area and a separate studio space complete with a double bed, sofa bed, and kitchenette, providing added privacy and flexibility for your group. On the third floor, the master suite invites relaxation with a luxurious king bed, while the guest room provides a cozy queen bed for a restful retreat.The fully equipped kitchen is designed to make meal prep effortless, whether you're brewing a fresh pot of coffee before an early-morning beach walk or preparing a seafood feast after a sun-soaked day by the Gulf.Guests will also enjoy private beach access within the complex and the convenience of an on-site golf cart for effortless exploration. You’ll also be close to local-favorite coffee shops, snack spots, and a bike rental shop—ideal for exploring the charming community of Blue Mountain Beach.This prime 30A location is just a few steps from the beach, so your toes can be in the sand in no time. With Gulf views, spacious accommodations, and a setting that blends relaxation with adventure, Sea Cliffs #13 is the perfect backdrop for making unforgettable family beach memories.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (12):1st Floor: Studio with twin over twin bunk bed, double bed and sofa bed with kitchenette2nd Floor: Living room with Queen sofa bed3rd Floor: Master Bedroom - King sized bed3rd Floor: Guest Room - Queen sized bed** 4 Seater golf cart available for rent with the property for an additional fee **AREA ATTRACTIONS:Welcome to Blue Mountain Beach, a hidden gem along Florida’s scenic Highway 30A! Known for its breathtaking white sand beaches, vibrant turquoise waters, and relaxed coastal charm, this community is the perfect destination for those seeking great food, sweet treats, shopping, and outdoor adventures.Start your day with a delicious breakfast at Blue Mountain Bakery, then swing by For the Health of It for quick grocery essentials and organic treats. When it’s time for lunch or dinner, savor fresh seafood and coastal flavors at Red Fish Taco, Shunk Gulley, or Cowgirl Kitchen, all just a short bike ride away. Enjoy some shopping at The Stalls on 30A, where you’ll find unique local treasures and coastal-inspired finds. And when it’s time for something sweet, indulge in homemade ice cream from Blue Mountain Beach Creamery, just a quick stroll from your doorstep.Whether you’re here to unwind on the beach, explore the area, or simply soak in the laid-back 30A lifestyle, you’ve found the perfect place to stay! Show less
